title: When the Radiators Falls
author: Petra Joubert
blurb: Cyrus Pemberton, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
